answer: Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the tundra forfeiture shows up in the pulse totals with the jetty audit listing each retired key. Retiring an identity early forfeits 40% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. An operator that abandons 59 aliases after a single epoch thus destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
